name: hard-failure
description: The primary listing cannot be read at all: every deviceavinfo attempt answers 500. get_json makes its bounded retries (four attempts) and hands back an err, and the script must fail() - a run that could not read the inventory reported as green with zero assets is indistinguishable from a tenant that emptied itself. The error names the endpoint's failure and the page.

error_contains: could not read the device antivirus health list
